remarks: This Dockside home is a short paddle away from Five Mile River. Quietly iconic. Effortlessly cool. Live large without living complicated. This is the rare waterfront home that offers the lifestyle of a grand estate with the ease of a true lock-and-leave retreat. Set on just over an acre in the private Tokeneke Association it's designed for living well not maintaining endlessly. There are four private bedrooms in the main house and several places to kick back. Escape whenever you choose a weekend, a week, or all the days in between. Paddle over to Rowayton for lunch, entertain under the stars by the fire, or spend an afternoon with a great book by the pool. A private guest cottage with multiple sleep configurations offers family and friends their own retreat while preserving yours. Waterfront homes that live this effortlessly are incredibly rare. A manageable home, beautiful grounds, a dock, freeform pool, an abundant vegetable garden and even a chicken coop, all within the security of Tokeneke including optional home check-ins while you're away. Make coming and going completely carefree, an easy house, an extraordinary life.
